rejected_rule.statement: An execution-debtor, or a transferee of the execution-debtor, can acquire a prescriptive title to property sold in execution by possessing it during the prescriptive period, even if the Fiscal's conveyance has not yet been issued.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "The possession that we have to deal with in the present case was clearly such a possession as is defined by section 31 (1871 Ordinance No. 22); and in the case of such a possession by an execution-debtor of his property sold in execution, Hutchinson C.J. was clearly of opinion that the possessor might acquire prescriptive rights under the Ordinance."

meta.parties: Sidambaram v. Punchi Banda Et Al
